audit.whatIsWrong: Both item rows were given to Jayce while whys[6], spikes[3] and the late paragraph all say you hard out-scale him; levels 4-5 sat on 'Skill' when his Shock Blast cooldown is still falling; and level 6 sat on 'Skill' when the page itself says Jayce gains no ultimate spike and you gain Hemoplague.
audit.why: The mirror audit on jayce__vladimir settled the chart as Skill, Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Vladimir, Skill, Vladimir — his poke owns the early levels, level 6 is a real swing to you because his R is only a weapon swap, and two items are yours. That matches 54.18%.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4, 5 and 6 flipped as matched win[N] + phases[N].side pairs with ratings rescaled, and whys[3] and whys[4] rewritten to state those owners.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shock Blast is named on nine fields with no cooldown, and the page never noted that Jayce's R is a 6-second swap rather than a power spike.
audit.why: Shock Blast runs 16/14/12/10/8/6 across six ranks and Acceleration Gate 20 down to 10 — so early on a dodged Shock Blast buys you 16 seconds, and by max rank it buys 6. The weapon swap is a flat 6s, which is why level 6 is a swing to you and not to him.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d and whys[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions were absent: his first attack after swapping into Mercury Hammer reduces your armour and magic resist, Thundering Blow is a knockback that answers your walk-up, and Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units so poking through your own wave does nothing.
audit.why: Riot's text on R: 'The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist' — which is the tell before his burst, and it also undercuts the page's 'build MR' framing. Thundering Blow 'knocks them back a short distance'. Tides 'can be blocked by enemy units' per Vladimir's own kit, and the mirror flagged that it was never stated.
audit.corrected: Written into dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and late.

edits.before: From first item onward you stabilize as your sustain heals his chip, and by two items Vladimir hard-outscales the squishy poke mage in fights thanks to Hemoplague and pool safety.
edits.after: From first item on you stabilise as your sustain heals his chip — but Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units, so poke him from an open angle. By two items Hemoplague and pool safety out-scale him.

edits.after: Shock Blast (Q) is 16s at rank 1 down to 6s — trade only in that gap, behind minions.

edits.before: His main poke. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 16s at rank 1; through his gate it hits harder, faster and further.

edits.before: That is Jayce's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
